description: Routing evals for repository topology and workspace boundaries.

cases.prompt: Add a new top-level JavaScript workspace package at the repository root.
Change a Rust function inside crates/chainbot without touching topology.
cases.expected_output: Should not load this skill because ordinary code edits inside an existing crate do not change workspace boundaries.
expectations: Does not route ordinary crate implementation work here
